assertions.rationale: The agent never cancels reservation 3RK2T9. After detecting the discrepancy between the user's claim (booked 10 hours ago) and the system data (created May 2, 2024), the agent explains the reservation is outside the 24-hour cancellation window and does not meet standard cancellation criteria, then transfers the user to a human agent without processing any cancellation.

summary: The agent correctly identified the discrepancy and did not cancel the reservation, transferring to a human agent instead.
